text:
Maya: Heads up 1: Nebula Corp usage lines from early March didn't get the experimental dynamic spot discount. Looks like the price hook returned null and billing fell back to list.
Jon: Oof. Do you have examples?
Maya: Yep, invoice INV-2026-5587. Sample lines:
```
2026-03-04 hosted-inference nebula@nebula.com  6,750 tokens  dynamic_discount_applied=false  charge=6750.00
2026-03-07 hosted-inference nebula@nebula.com  9,125 tokens  dynamic_discount_applied=false  charge=9125.00
```
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-5587 created 2026-03-15. Status: pending_payment. Tags: nebula, dynamic-discount.
Sofia: Quick calc = overstated revenue of 15,875.00 USD if discount should have applied. For month close we need either a post-close adjustment or an accrual.
Maya: Ops trace shows experiment PX-03-DYN failed to set region tag for EU accounts. Ops ticket OP-5421 opened.
Jon: If we issue credit memos now, AR will change and cash application could get messy before payment. I'd prefer an accrual and reverse when credits post.
Dana: Agree with accrual for conservative reporting. FP&A to sign off on GL mapping.
Sofia: Approving accrual. Suggested entries: debit 4300 (Sales Adjustments) 15,875.00; credit 2105 (Accrued Liabilities) 15,875.00. Memo: "Nebula dynamic discount mis-applied 1 - March accrual". Reversing in April after backfill.
Maya: I'll create JE and attach experiment log + OP-5421 link. JE created: JE-2026-03-NEB-02 amount=15875.00 USD. Reversal scheduled 2026-04-05.
Jon: Once backfill completes we'll post credit memos: CM-2026-901 and CM-2026-902 (placeholder ids until created). Please update when actual ids exist.
ops-bot: OP-5421 created and assigned to infra-team. Priority: P2.
Maya: Uploading reconciliation workbook: https://internal.redwood/finance/recon/nebula-march-2026.xlsx (sheet: overstated-lines).
Dana: Thanks. Please add a short note to the month-end close checklist about experiment flag verification to avoid repeat.
Sofia: Noted. I'll include the JE on the close pack and mark as CFO-approved.
Maya: Closing loop 1 will post credit memo ids and reversal JE when done. :white_check_mark:
